meta.title: Stock ticker (quote strip, A-share / HK / US)
meta.description: A configurable watchlist quote strip under the composer for A-share, Hong Kong and US symbols: name, code, price, change percent, limit-up/down marker and a mini daily K-line, with a detail panel offering intraday, 5-minute, daily, weekly and monthly charts, five-level order book and bid/ask ratio, plus A-share turnover, volume ratio, amplitude, P/E, P/B and market cap. Symbols are edited in the strip and saved to the profile config, or set in cordis.patch.yml. Quotes come from Tencent's public endpoints with Sina as a fallback; the refresh cadence follows the trading session and backs off when requests fail. Display only: no orders, and no session or agent data is read. Turning it off removes the strip.
